build_vit_model: build a Vision Transformer model using the ViT class with image_size, patch_size, num_classes, dim, and transformer parameters
create_pair_helper: create a pair helper function that converts a scalar to a tuple or returns the tuple as-is
test_vit_forward: test the ViT forward pass by passing a batch of images and verifying classification output
